goal: Define a reviewable, non-production cross-polis continuity-transfer contract over landed v0.92 birthday evidence.
required_outcome: A field-level movement-semantics design that rejects copied state, quarantines ambiguity, preserves redaction, and leaves infrastructure and governance authority downstream.
task_boundary: Author the WP-17 continuity-transfer feature/design notes and v0.93 handoff inputs without implementing Runtime, storage, networking, or migration behavior.
plan_summary: Verify #5826, #5827, and #5834; reconcile landed schemas; author the transfer matrix and WP-04 boundary; validate links, redaction, copied-state rejection, and forbidden production claims; then obtain exact-head review.
review_scope: Review only the WP-17 transfer contract, design note, v0.93 handoff edits, issue proof, and their exact candidate paths for evidence fidelity, copied-state rejection, privacy, and WP-04/v0.93 boundary discipline.
operator_constraints: Preparation bind does not authorize product implementation
Use typed C-SDLC v2 cards and exact-revision review
Do not edit main or absorb WP-04 or v0.93 authority
Release the preparation claim before handoff

authority_boundary: WP-17 owns documentation-only movement semantics and explicit non-goals
WP-04 retains Runtime, storage, networking, and distributed polis infrastructure
v0.93 retains citizenship, standing, rights, and governance decisions
initial_assumptions: #5834 supplies the integrated birthday review packet

deliverables: Cross-polis continuity design note with WP-04 boundary
Copied-state, ambiguity, redaction, and forbidden-claim validation evidence
dependencies: #5826 / WP-09 complete at current exact revision
#5827 / WP-10 complete at current exact revision
#5834 / WP-16 complete at current exact revision
non_goals: Production migration, federation, portability, or key lifecycle
Runtime, storage, network, or WP-04 implementation

invariants: Copied state is never continuity proof
Private state moves only as governed redacted references
Production and governance authority remain downstream
risks: Migration prose could overclaim operational portability
A transfer row could expose private state
Landed dependency schemas may differ from planning names
stop_conditions: Any dependency is not current and accepted
Required schema or evidence path is absent
The design cannot preserve lineage or redaction without widening scope
replan_triggers: Landed identity/continuity schema changes field names
v0.93 allocation requires a different handoff shape

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The transfer matrix covers every declared birthday artifact with portability, locality, governance, transport, lineage, and redaction dispositions.
AC-2: Copied, conflicting, ambiguous, and raw-private-state cases fail closed or quarantine explicitly.
AC-3: The feature/design notes preserve the exact boundary against WP-04 and v0.93 authority.
AC-4: Every cited path resolves and forbidden production/governance claims are absent.
AC-5: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.

steps.action: Verify #5826, #5827, and #5834 exact dependency truth and landed schemas
Author the transfer matrix and continuity-transfer design note
Update only concrete v0.93 handoff inputs
Run path, redaction, copied-state, ambiguity, and forbidden-claim validation
Resolve exact-head review and retain proof

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove all transfer rows, source paths, and WP-04/v0.93 boundaries are complete.
Reject copied/conflicting state, raw-memory transfer, and production/governance overclaim.
Prove clean patch structure before exact-head review.

review_prompts: Does every movement-semantics row cite landed v0.92 evidence and preserve lineage?
Can copied, ambiguous, or private state be misread as transferable continuity?
Does any text absorb WP-04 infrastructure or v0.93 governance authority?
Are the exact candidate paths and validation artifacts independently usable?
